title: Interfaces
description:
Public functions of MIPP, one entry per function. The generator derives from it the names and the signatures in the three APIs: `mipp_add_float32`, `mipp_add_float32_maskz`, `mipp_add_float32_m2` in C, `mipp::add` in C++.

Checked when the file is loaded: `proto_ref` exists in `registry_protos.json`, the function has a scalar implementation for each of its datatypes and mask variants ([Scalar Implementations](scalar_implems.md)), and it is in at most one category ([Categories](categories.md)).

datatypes.description: Datatypes of the function: an alias of `DATATYPES_MAP` (`helpers_headers/tools.py`), such as `all_datatypes`, `all_float`, `all_int`, `all_uint`, `all_32bit`, or a pair alias for the conversions (`all_datatypes_same_size`, `all_datatypes_widenning`, ...), or an explicit list.

horizontal.description: `true` for the functions that combine the lanes of a register (reductions such as `hadd`, `hmax`). Their LMUL > 1 versions come from the `lmulh` generic templates instead of two calls on halves.

variants.description: Variants of the function: `u` (unmasked, always present), `m` (Merge-Masked), `z` (Zero-Masked), `s` (Source-Masked). `["u"]`: no mask variant; `["u", "m", "z", "s"]`: all of them.

lane_crossing.description: `true` for the functions that move lanes across the register (reverse, slide, zip_lo...), on the whole register and the whole LMUL group: the LMUL > 1 versions of the ISAs with a software LMUL are not two calls on the halves but the templates of `generic_emu_implems_lmulh.json` (a missing one is an error), and the half-vector of the ISAs whose d2 is a masked register goes through the scalar d2 function. Default `false`.

cpp_name.description: Name of the function in the C++ APIs when it differs from the C name: `get_k` is `mipp::get`.

forms.description: Scalar forms of the function (see [Scalar Forms](../../user/scalar_forms.md)): one string per form, with one letter per data register argument of the prototype, `v` (register) or `s` (scalar of the type of the function, broadcast to every lane). `"forms": ["vs", "sv"]` on `sub` gives `sub_vs(r, s)` and `sub_sv(s, r)` (C: `mipp_sub_vs_float32`, C++: overloads of `mipp::sub`). Each form is a function of its own, derived when the registry is loaded (`helpers_headers/forms.py`): prototype, category, scalar reference and a generic Level 2 body (the base function with the scalar broadcast), whose level is the one of the base. The all-`v` form is the base function itself.

imm.description: Values of the integer argument when it is a constant (`lt_n`: [0, N), `le_n`: [0, N], `lt_nb` / `le_nb`: the same with the lanes of a block of 128 bits, `lt_bits`: [0, bits of the elements)): the ISAs that have immediate bodies for the function (`<isa>_imm_implems.json`) start its unmasked LMUL 1 version with a dispatch on these values, used when the argument is known at compile time (see `codegen/imm.py`), and the C++ APIs have a template version `f<N>(...)`.
